# I202: the actual Foulkes deficiency module

It is enough to work in dimension seven. In the source normalization algebra, with C=R/A regarded as an A-module, the target is exactly A_1^2 C_6=0. Neither this target nor the ordinary seventh Foulkes case is proved or refuted here.

More generally, for every odd prime p and every finite-dimensional complex V, the rectangular submodule S_((p-1)^p)V survives in C_(p-1) for a=p and is annihilated by A_1. It is nonzero when dim V>=p and is a socle submodule. The [analytic record](../experiments/i202_foulkes_quotient/analytic-attempt.md), §2.1, gives the exact statement and full proof, including extension from dimension p to arbitrary dimension.

The odd-prime socle family is a proved auxiliary result in this attempt. It is not certified new to the literature or substantial enough for nomination: determinant contractions and their Latin-square relationship are established in Kumar–Landsberg, and the nonvanishing input is Kotlar's known theorem. The [literature record](../sources/i202_foulkes_quotient/literature.md) states the primary-source boundaries explicitly. No novelty claim follows from unsuccessful searches.

Screen at most three potentially less-explored source families200 (Eisenbud–Green–Harris/lex-plus-powers),204 (typeD tensor saturation),208 (finite symmetric tensor categories and higher Verlinde fiber functors), with focused overlap check against earlier relevant algebra reports. Seek a concrete substantial structural theorem beyond routine inequality substitution, standard fiber-functor transport, and direct saturation corollaries. A new uniform bound, construction, or obstruction in a named residual problem is preferable. You may substitute one unspent neighboring algebra family if all three already exhausted. Prior Foulkes quotient and odd-prime socle lanes are technical/unresolved and must not be recycled. Choose one target early and do real proof work with two routes, not a long catalogue survey. No assumption that a new target is attainable.

* **200, EGH/lex-plus-powers:** the actual Betti manuscript supplies the full characteristic-zero inequality and its division-linear filtered Koszul construction; its companion supplies the triangular identities and full ordered basis. The initial target was a consecutive-cancellation strengthening. This led to two different routes: filtered resolutions and actual scalar degeneration. The latter failed and led instead to a quantitative obstruction on the auxiliary division algebra.

* **208, higher Verlinde functors:** the actual introduction and consequences already include finite-category existence, incompressible classification, characteristic-two uniqueness and internal reconstruction. I104 already distinguishes these from the nonfinite moderate-growth problem. No replacement for the projective-generator and finite-simple descent inputs was found; the old target was not recycled as a new result.

The focused prior-report comparison used I104's V104/S104 passages, the old I28 algebra brief/report, and I198's algebra overlap/contribution discussion. Direct iteration-title searches found no earlier family-200 proof report in the inspected scope. That is a project-local search statement, not a claim of worldwide novelty. Foulkes quotient and odd-prime socle arguments were not used. No live other-agent output was read.

The reproducible screens cover order three, odd order/prime, ternary/six-tip, realization/Nielsen/outer automorphisms, cyclic covers, marked bodies, grope/cap operations, arbitrary laws and arity. A second pass normalizes whitespace so a line break does not hide a phrase. Broad matches include unrelated algebraic threefolds and cyclic covers. The relevant marked-body/realization chain remains the four manuscripts below. The Singer companion's actual main theorem concerns L²-Betti vanishing for finite aspherical PD4 complexes; its cyclic-cover discussion concerns branched-cover examples, not a manifold-model spectrum or outer realization. The hyperbolic/non-CAT(0) and Eilenberg–Ganea companions concern metric models and geometric dimension, respectively, not the claimed closed-manifold Homeo-image obstruction.

**Kumar–Landsberg.** [Proposition 2.1](https://people.tamu.edu/~jml/KLfoulkeshowefinal.pdf) constructs the multiplicity-one rectangular invariant of degree d on degree-r forms in d variables for even r, by symmetrized determinant contractions. Its proof checks symmetry, invariance and nonzero evaluation. Their Theorem 1.9 concerns the even-order square Alon–Tarsi problem, not the odd-prime socle statement. The construction, however, applies with d=p and r=p-1, and is enough to recover the covariant used here by the explicit substitution below. Calling the entire method a new odd-order contraction would miss this overlap.

**Further representation-theoretic comparison.** [Kumar, Sections 2–6](https://arxiv.org/abs/1109.5996v2) supplies the rectangular invariant construction, the translation from nonzero evaluation to actual coordinate-ring occurrence, and the Latin-rectangle/isotypic-component comparison. Its principal results are for even form degree and rectangular weights. They do not state annihilation of this odd-degree quotient constituent. In particular the partition of the multiplication image here, (2p-1,(p-1)^(p-1)), is not the rectangular conclusion of those theorems. The ordinary Foulkes comparison and actual canonical image must remain distinct.

There is a recognized mathematical setting: the paragraph after Remark 2.9 of Raicu–Sam–Weyman asks for further study of C and of the least stabilization degree; Problem 3.3 asks for resolutions of their modules of covariants. The present family gives limited structural data in that setting. It neither determines C nor its resolution or least stabilization degree. It cannot inherit the full significance of those open-ended problems merely by furnishing one constituent family. No new consequence for Rota's basis conjecture, a GCT obstruction, or the general Foulkes comparison is demonstrated by this argument.
